item.title: Spotify eases rules for video podcast monetisation
item.description: Spotify is lowering the eligibility requirements for podcasters to earn money from video content on its platform, easing thresholds set when the program launched last year, according to TechCrunch. Under the revised criteria, creators need at least three published episodes, 2,000 consumption hours, and 1,000 engaged audience members over the past 30 days to qualify. item.title: Google rolls out new Gemini in Gmail with multiple features
item.description: Google is introducing a new set of artificial intelligence features in Gmail, aiming to help users manage growing volumes of email and find information more easily. The updates are powered by Gemini, Google’s AI system, and are beginning to roll out in the United States in English. item.title: Cinepolis India partners with It’s Spotlight to roll out digital ad screens
item.description: Cinépolis India has partnered with digital out-of-home media agency It’s Spotlight to expand into cinema advertising with the rollout of digital screens across its cinema lobbies nationwide. The agency will operate and commercialise its advertising inventory. The deployment includes more than 350 LED screens, video walls and digital displays across 101 Cinépolis cinemas in 63 cities, covering 23 states and Union Territories. item.title: ICC names Marriott Bonvoy as official accommodation partner for men’s events
item.description: Marriott Bonvoy has entered into a partnership with the International Cricket Council (ICC) to serve as the ICC’s official accommodation partner through 2029. Under the agreement, Marriott International’s loyalty platform will be associated with all major ICC men’s tournaments over the next four years. item.title: Tata Mumbai Marathon announces brand partners for 21st edition
item.description: The Tata Mumbai Marathon has added battery maker AMARON, confectionery brand Snickers and beverage company Red Bull as brand partners for the 21st edition of the annual race. It will be held on Sunday, January 18, 2026. The event is promoted by Procam International.
